topic: Project Details - NeuroCare (AI Powered Appointment Booking Platform)
content: Project Name: AI Powered Appointment Booking Platform [NEUROCARE][cite: 1]. Tech Stack: React.js, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, GSAP, Node.js/Express, MongoDB, Groq API, Cloudinary[cite: 1]. Deep Breakdown: Healthcare application featuring role-based access control (RBAC) across 3 distinct personas: Patient, Doctor, and Admin[cite: 1]. Groq API Integration: Embedded Groq API to power an intelligent AI assistant capable of recommending doctors based on patient symptoms/illness and location, as well as offering preventive healthcare guidance[cite: 1]. Authentication: Implemented Email OTP and Google OAuth for account verification and profile setup[cite: 1]. Workflow Architecture: Engineered a 3-stage admin-controlled appointment pipeline (Request -> Admin Review/Approval -> Final Confirmation) designed to restrict doctor access to appointment requests until administrator approval is granted[cite: 1]. Technical Features: Built automated A4 prescription PDF generation, integrated Cloudinary for profile avatar management, recorded medical history logs, and maintained persistent AI chat histories stored via MongoDB[cite: 1].
